structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE: each unit's discover → understand → synthesize before its build — discover/understand ride ungated packets; the synthesis is the gated increment here closing its own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF; THE PRECEDENCE: no build unit's dispatch fires until its brief gate is green. THE ROUTE GROWS UNIT-BY-UNIT per the ruled six-unit decomposition (registry first at birth; scheduler, votes, tally, session, acceptance — each unit's pipeline and build increments ride its own composition amendment at its turn)
structure.entry_condition: the route is composed registry-first; no build dispatch fires until its unit's brief gate is green (the precedence law, amendment 19's form at the birth store)

structure.purpose: THE REGISTRY UNIT'S BUILD — the first increment of the six-unit decomposition (Q-granularity's ruling at the birth store): the item registry + the core schemas — register_run's manifest (RUN-{####}, frozen), the opaque (id, label) rows, the operator declaration with its verdict set, the ruled refusals — the root vocabulary every downstream unit cites
structure.entry_condition: G-REGISTRY-BRIEF is green — the brief is the spec (the exact-task law); the build fires only after

steps.tool: make dev && make test && make lint && make typecheck at the prioritree root

conditions: togo's registry brief lands at synthesize/registry-brief.md — the exact-task spec for the registry unit: the opaque item rows (id + label), the operator declaration (id + stated question + declared verdict set, default the weak-order triple {prefer-a, prefer-b, tie}), the run manifest (register_run minting RUN-{####}, frozen at registration, quorum k=1 as policy-as-data), and the refusals (<2 items, duplicate ids, schema violations — expected/found/next-action naming the legal set)
the brief cites its ground: the scope rulings at the prioritree-birth store (Q-granularity R1/R2/R3, Q-solution-space R4/R8, the five-op interface) and synthesize/scope-synthesis.md PART 2/3

the registry module lands per the brief — the exact-task law: the brief is the spec

duplicate-id refusal verified; the <2-items refusal verified — the empty list and the single item are named refusals, not special rankings
pyright 0 errors 0 warnings and ruff zero findings on the landed code — the zero-findings bar, zero ignores
kensho's independent re-run green — the read-back is the evidence, not the build's word

THE BUILD BRIEF for the unit probe LANDED and APPROVED: togo's synthesis over the unit's discovery census (discover/probe) + mechanism analysis (understand/probe) — the brief carrying the banked shapes, the scope fence, and the return forms — the dispatches cite this brief

the canonical pair form: every pair canonically id-sorted — the form every vote cites (the seam pinned at this unit's brief; votes' records and U3's ground-truth checks ride it)

order-stable across runs: the same id-set (and the ruled seed derivation) yields the byte-identical enumeration — deterministic enumeration, replays byte-match; the empty/1-item edges yield the empty queue (the total-function form; the registry's <2 refusal means the ruled flow never hands the scheduler fewer than two)

amendments.what: VOIDED — THE PROBE PAIR: build/probe (build stage, owner jikko, gate G-REGISTRY), synthesize/probe (pipeline stage, owner togo), and the auto-minted G-PROBE-BRIEF — retired numbers, never referenced again (GitHub semantics: the records stand, the void names them). The probe was the convenor's one diagnostic call that revealed the engine's pairing model: a build-stage add-increment AUTO-STAMPS the unit's pair (synthesize/<unit> in the pipeline + the auto-minted G-<UNIT>-BRIEF) from the increment id's last segment, and REFUSES when the pipeline counterpart already exists.
amendments.why: The registry unit's pair (G-REGISTRY-BRIEF + synthesize/registry) was composed manually BEFORE the build add — inverting the engine's order and permanently blocking build/registry (the auto-stamp would duplicate). The probe isolated the derivation (id-segment, not gate) at the cost of three stray records; voiding them keeps the structure honest while preserving the lesson in the ledger.

amendments.what: THE COMPOSITION MODEL (ruled at the store's birth): the route grows unit-by-unit per the six-unit decomposition (Q-granularity's ruling at the prioritree-birth store: registry, scheduler, votes, tally, session, acceptance — U1 → {U2, U3} → U4 → U5 → U6). THE REGISTRY UNIT (first) rides the AMEND FLOW — the engine's sanctioned path for its manually-composed pair: synthesize/registry IS the unit's increment (togo, G-REGISTRY-BRIEF — the synthesize leg, current and correct); when the brief gate greens, the build leg advances BY AMENDMENT (amend-increment owner → jikko, gate → G-REGISTRY), and the build work rides packets (the build/registry packet form) with gate outcomes recorded against G-REGISTRY. THE FIVE REMAINING UNITS ride the BUILD-ADD PRIMITIVE (add-increment build/<unit> with the unit's build gate passed via --gate) — the engine auto-stamps each pair whole (synthesize/<unit> + G-<UNIT>-BRIEF); their build gates are minted manually with rich conditions BEFORE their build adds. THE PRECEDENCE HOLDS: no unit's build dispatch fires until its brief gate is green.
amendments.why: The pairing model learned from the probe (amendment 7) fixes the composition order for every future unit; the registry unit's manual pair (rich gate conditions, correct owners) is kept rather than wasted — the amend flow is the engine's own next-action for exactly this state, and the amendments ledger records the leg advance with full provenance.

amendments.what: THE EXECUTION DECOMPOSITION DOCTRINE (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-20): jikko is execute — a dispatched execution leaves NOTHING for jikko to figure out. Execution dispatches decompose to a much greater degree: each step carries its exact target content (THE FENCED-BYTES PRECEDENT — the birth route's own brief form: fenced code blocks landed byte-exact by the build seat), the exact commands, and the exact expected outcomes. The build seat's act is mechanical application + verification, never interpretation: no spec-to-code translation at the execution seat. A fat or ambiguous execution dispatch is FR-MEM-0049's class in the live channel — the empty return at FR-MEM-0010 correlates with exactly this. THE APPLIED FORM: the spec's bytes are composed at the synthesis tier (togo authors the exact file contents as fenced blocks); the execution decomposes per file, per step — land, floor, read-back — each dispatch small, mechanical, unambiguous.
amendments.why: The build dispatch failed as one large ambiguous act: "the brief is the spec" delegated interpretation to the execution seat, which is out of grammar — execution is mechanical. The fenced-bytes precedent (the birth route's §1.1(c) blocks) is the proven form: bytes at the synthesis tier, mechanical application at the build seat.

amendments.what: THE SINGLE-GOAL DOCTRINE (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-20): SINGLE-GOAL DISPATCHES ARE BEST PRACTICE — every dispatch, to ANY seat (semantic seats included), carries exactly ONE goal. Multi-goal compositions decompose into one-goal dispatches fired in sequence (or parallel where stateless); the deliberation surface shrinks to a single unambiguous act and quality rises with it. Payload size is NOT deliberation — a dispatch may carry large exact content (the fenced bytes) while remaining one goal; goals are what count. THE APPLIED FORM for the registry build: the execution decomposes to (1) land src/prioritree/registry.py — one goal, the addendum's Deliverable 1, byte-exact via patch + re-read; (2) land tests/test_registry.py — one goal, Deliverable 2; (3) run the floor — one goal, the four make commands with their expected outcomes; (4) the read-back — one goal, both files against the addendum. Each fires as its own dispatch; each returns its own report.
amendments.why: The collaborator's correction: togo was overloaded too — the three-deliverable authoring dispatch was a multi-goal act. Single-goal dispatches reduce deliberation and achieve high-quality outcomes; the form applies to semantic seats as much as execution seats, prospectively and in the live lane.

amendments.what: THE REGISTRY CURE RULINGS (collaborator, 2026-11-20, "proceed with recommendations"): (1) N818 — RENAME RegistryRefused → RegistryRefusedError (the zero-ignore cure, adopted over the per-file-ignore alternative): the exception joins the family's Error-suffixed grammar (RefusedError precedent) before any downstream unit cites the name; the brief's §2 symbol name is amended accordingly — the brief's other terms stand. (2) The remaining findings are mechanical authoring cures at togo's hand, adopted as a set: C901 (register_run splits into private validators — the object-typed private validators also cure the four reportUnnecessaryIsInstance findings, the honest form where runtime validation IS the boundary), PLR2004 (the pair-length 2 becomes a named constant), the five reportImplicitStringConcatenation findings (explicit concatenation), tests I001 + COM812 (import order + trailing comma). The loop: togo re-authors each file (single-goal dispatches per amendment 15), the cured bytes land as registry-bytes-v2.md, jikko lands them byte-exact, the floor runs green (13 passed, zero findings, 0/0/0), kensho re-runs independently, G-REGISTRY closes on the evidence.
amendments.why: The zero-findings bar stands (an ignore is a ruling, never a convenience); the rename is cheapest now, before U2-U6 cite the symbol; the object-typed-private-validator form is the standard pyright-strict cure that keeps runtime validation honest rather than annotation-blind.

amendments.what: THE G-REGISTRY CLOSURE RULING (the collaborator, 2026-11-20): G-REGISTRY closes GREEN on the combined evidence — (1) jikko's floor: 13 passed zero warnings, ruff "All checks passed!", pyright "0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 informations"; (2) the patch harness's riding checks: zero findings rode the final mutations (ruff and pyright both silent at the last applies); (3) kensho's independent re-run: the suite green in a fresh process (13 passed in 0.01s) and the full content read-back — every named item confirmed (the Error-suffixed class, the five object-boundary validators, the mint, the copy-in freeze, the return shape, zero ignores, zero adjacent literals, the cast forms, the cured bad_sets). THE GRANT GAP, HONESTLY RULED: kensho's lint/typecheck legs could not run at kensho's hand (no lint act granted to the kensho pack; FR-MEM-0013) — the gap rides the ledger as the tool-grants lane's follow-up (route lint to kensho at the next hikari regen), and the closure rests on the combined evidence per this ruling, not on a silent assumption. The gate's evidence record: build/registry-verification.md.
amendments.why: The deterministic evidence is three-way green at independent paths; the single blocked leg is an instrument-grant gap (an environment fact, FR-MEM-0013), not a code fact; holding the gate for the grant would stall the unit on a harness-lane widening with zero bearing on the landed bytes' correctness.

amendments.what: THE CURE-EXECUTION DEVIATIONS (shinko's hand applying togo's delta, 2026-11-20 — recorded for the record): (1) L3 and L5 (the verdict-set and read_manifest next_action texts) were converted from togo's single-line verdicts to the bridge form — togo's line-length arithmetic missed the true indentation (both land over 120 chars single-line); the bridges are togo's own pattern. (2) The Unknown-leakage cures (P1-P7) took cast forms — pyright EMPIRICALLY rejects the declared-binding pattern (raw: Sequence[object] = items flags as Sequence[Unknown]); the working form is cast("Sequence[object]", ...) — a typed assertion, never an ignore. (3) The ItemRow branch's label isinstance-check was DELETED (pyright judged it redundant against the dataclass's declared label: str — the typed path is trusted; the untyped paths keep their checks). (4) Three transcription defects at shinko's patch hand, caught and cured same-turn by the strict loop: a context-only patch (junk blanks at 389-390, reverted); a miscounted block-close (an orphaned ), after the duplicates single-line, removed); an indent error in a pre-image (the strict tool refused; refired). The landed files: registry.py 405 lines, test_registry.py 178 lines; the floor's three-way green is the evidence.
amendments.why: The deviations record keeps the cure execution honest — the delta as authored and the delta as applied differ in three named ways, each empirically forced by the checkers' own behavior; the record is the difference's provenance.

THE KENSHO LINT GRANT (amendment 42 at the birth store, the collaborator's hand — FR-MEM-0013's follow-up): the independence leg's re-dispatch failed fast — the grant is on disk (lint.ts wrapper, the opencode.json permission, the regenerated pack row, all read back at HEAD) but kensho's session predates the regen; an opencode restart delivers it (FR-MEM-0014, open — FR-MEM-0007/0008's stale-session class); the two-leg re-dispatch rides the next session.
